rationale: At docs/issue-209-efficiency-analysis.md:920 in b7350303a36ae034588e51fa9d4df8b8edcd53c6, retries must require live ready-prompt/action-absent proof, the applicable delivery wait, and lifecycle/queue/send-budget checks under docs/readiness-policy.md:165–174; missing prompt-submitted confirmation after successful delivery can otherwise cause a duplicate prompt into active work, so replace the silence-based retry recommendation in both the report and comment with the existing positive-proof rule.
